description: The caller's UpFork account: their name and role, what they bought, and, while UpFork's paid plans are on, the plan they're on and what's left of its limits today. The user signs in to UpFork for it (the app asks them the first time).
name: my_account

outputSchema.description: The caller's UpFork account: their plan, what's left of its limits, and what they bought.

exempt.description: Why nothing they do counts against a plan (admin, developer, not_live), or null.

limits.description: Today's (and this month's) use of their plan's limits.

items.description: A use of the caller's plan and its limit.

use.description: download (files, code ZIPs, CLI installs), prompt (AI prompts) or any (the two together). Demos are never counted.

plan.description: The plan they're on; null while UpFork's paid plans are off.

planEndsAt.description: When it ends; null for Free, a plan with no end, or while the plans are off.

pricingUrl.description: Where to see the plans and buy one; null while they're off.

url.description: Null once the product is gone from UpFork.

title: Your UpFork account
